github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Use imperative mood: 'add', 'fix', 'update', not past tense.
Keep subject under 50 characters. No period.
Describe the intent clearly. Avoid vague messages like 'update code'.
Use only these types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, chore, ci.
Include a scope when the change targets a specific area.
Ensure each commit represents one logical change.
Add a body when needed, separated by a blank line.
Use bullet points (*) in the body for multiple changes.
Explain why the change was made, not only what changed.
Add BREAKING CHANGE: in the footer when applicable.
